description: AISdb provides an open-source AIS database tool for collecting, cleaning, querying and combining vessel tracks with environmental data. The provider is Spadon, Gabriel; Kumar, Jay; Chen, Jinkun; Smith, Matthew; Hilliard, Casey; Vela, Sarah; Gehrmann, Romina; DiBacco, Claudio; Matwin, Stan; Pelot, Ronald. Geographical and temporal coverage: The platform integrates multiple AIS sources; actual geographic and temporal coverage depends on the source data. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: not stated for the software; the describing arXiv preprint is under the arXiv non-exclusive distribution licence. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: AIS inputs are high-volume and error-prone; the platform does not guarantee that all source observations are accessible. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration.
